headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and security checks to improve ClearInstall's risk assessment capabilities, ensuring users are informed about potential vulnerabilities before installation. Leverage AI-driven insights for better binding.gyp command expansions, enhancing the app’s accuracy and reliability.
actions: Implement real-time dependency analysis using signals from projects like dsh-Go (5321) to detect emerging security threats in dependencies.
Utilize AI-driven risk assessment models inspired by openidea (4197) to provide more accurate and context-aware warnings about potential risks during installati
Enhance the binding.gyp command expansion feature with insights from dsh-superagent-prototype (10709) to ensure compatibility and security in cross-platform dev
